course.title: SFCC Backend Engineering
course.subtitle: Commerce Cloud past the tutorials
course.summary: Build the parts of a Salesforce Commerce Cloud storefront that carry money. Cart, checkout, payments, jobs and the OCAPI/SCAPI surface.
overview: Most SFCC learning material stops at rendering a product page. The work that actually gets you hired starts after that, in the cart, the checkout and the integrations that connect a storefront to payments, fraud checks and order management.
This course covers that second half. It follows the same path I have shipped on client projects, which means the failure cases are included rather than skipped.
whatYouWillLearn: Structure cartridges and controllers so platform upgrades stay cheap
Extend cart and checkout behaviour through hooks rather than overrides
Design OCAPI and SCAPI contracts that a mobile client can build against
Integrate payment and fraud providers with sane failure behaviour
Write jobs for order export, OMS handoff and settlement that fail loudly
Profile and fix the storefront paths that cost conversion

curriculum.title: Cart architecture
lessons: Custom plugins without fighting the platform

curriculum.title: Checkout and payments
lessons: Fraud verification off the user path

curriculum.title: OCAPI and SCAPI
lessons: Designing a middleware layer for mobile

curriculum.title: Jobs, monitoring and delivery
lessons: Logging and alerting that gets noticed

audience: SFCC developers who have shipped storefront features and want the backend depth
Backend engineers moving onto a commerce platform for the first time
Full-stack developers who own checkout and want to stop being afraid of it
prerequisites: Comfortable with JavaScript, including asynchronous code
Some exposure to SFRA or another commerce platform
